summary: Craft shaped an evidence-bounded early visual direction around a station-timetable composition: two direct revenue paths, verified room utility, central-location proof, and event capacity. The system commits to cobalt operational blue, signal-red accents, flat diagrammatic imagery, a display/body pairing, and a mobile-native single-route rhythm. External image generation was intentionally not used because the brief forbids external service calls and no licensed local photography was supplied.
